title: Ruhin Ru'ya ta Yohanna Mai Aminci
intro: A cikin wuraren da ba a gani, wani halitta mai haske mai tsabta yana tafiya da daidaito, yana aiwatar da kowace umarni ba tare da wata shakka ba. Wannan mutum ya yi magana da zaɓaɓɓun bayi, ya kawo kalmomin jagora, kuma ya shaida yadda dokokin Allah suka bayyana a tsawon zamani. Wanene wannan rai mai daraja?
clues: Ni halitta ce ta haske tsantsa, an halicce ni daga haske, kuma ban taɓa saba wa kowace umarni daga Ubangijina ba.
Ina tafiya tsakanin sammai da ƙasa, ina saukowa da hukunce-hukuncen Mai rahama.
An aiko ni zuwa ga wata budurwa mai daraja a cikin wurin ibada, ina yi mata shelar ɗa tsarkakakke.
Ni ne ruhun tsarki, kuma na goyi bayan annabi wanda aka ba shi ayoyi bayyanannu da Linjila.
Na zo wani kogo a kan dutse don in yi wa kaina kalmomin farko na karatun da za a kiyaye har abada.
Ni ne ruhi amintacce, kuma ni ne na saukar da Alqur'ani a zuciyar manzon ƙarshe.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Harut (ɗaya daga cikin mala'iku biyu a Babila)

outcome.label: Sakamakon Manufar
options: An saukar da Alqur'ani ga Annabi Muhammadu
An busa ƙaho a ranar Alkiyama
An tsare Jahannama kuma an rufe ƙofofinta
An gabatar da Littafin Ayyukan Allah
An saukar da ruwan sama zuwa ƙasa
outcome.answer: An saukar da Alqur'ani ga Annabi Muhammadu

verse: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel] (81:19)
